d.ko: Battle through an onslaught of mystical backwater cultists, possessed militants & even darker forces as you attempt to discover just what lurks beneath the Earth in this retro FPS inspired by the '90s legends.
d.en: Battle through an onslaught of mystical backwater cultists, possessed militants & even darker forces as you attempt to discover just what lurks beneath the Earth in this retro FPS inspired by the '90s legends.
d.zh: 在这款充满90年代风格的游戏中，玩家将与敌人展开激战，消灭那些好战分子甚至是黑暗势力,并试图发现地球之下潜藏着的秘密。

rv.t: 퀘이크 시리즈를 재미있게 했다면. 둠 리부트, 혹은 오리지널과 2편을 재미있게 했다면. 울트라킬을 재미있게 했다면.

One of the better introductions for boomer shooters overall. DUSK is a fast based FPS perfection. It's amazing.
Among the many "boomer shooter" clone games, this one stands out. If there was ever a game within the genre to look at, it's this one
The first episode is a 10/10 experience but the game becomes incredibly repetetive after that. There arent any new weapons after the first chapter and the enemies are all just reskins
无所畏惧难度全收集通关，很不错的FPS，就是有些jump scare内容有点吓人。
一流的射击手感，和谐统一的美术风格，一路高开高走的关卡设计，关卡氛围和音乐极佳，剧情也是几十年前的味道，虽然是很典型的凡人被邪神愚弄结局，不过看起来主角的故事还没结束，期待续作。 …
🟢关卡场景类型丰富，风格迥异，低多边形美术、DOS启动界面、老式硬盘读写音效，复古视觉质感非常纯正。 🟢没有限速的高速移动，非常流畅，手感做得相当出色，加速、空中变向都很丝滑。 …
